app.title: Show HN: PaperMono, e-ink fridge magnet shopping list with mobile web page
app.author: seamus_c
app.description: A mobile-friendly web app that turns a shopping list into an e‑ink fridge magnet display.
proposed_tests: Start dev server with `npm start` and verify page loads at localhost:3000
Build production bundle with `npm run build` and check bundle size
Run end‑to‑end test with Playwright against the / list creation flow
